Hyperprolactinemia can suppress GnRH pulsatility, delaying menarche and causing functional ovarian inhibition, while also contributing to sebum overproduction via prolactin’s effect on adrenal and ovarian steroidogenesis. Turner syndrome (45,X) must be considered in primary amenorrhea, but severe acne is atypical (due to estrogen deficiency and lack of ovarian androgens); its inclusion reflects the need to rule out chromosomal disorders before age 15, though confidence is lower given the acne phenotype."}
